_about: How much louder SSO's Performance legato plays its accented attack (velocity 122) than its spiccato attack at velocity 64 (the note [slurs] plainPerformance plays), per played pitch and note length: [slurs] plainAccents 2 / 3 play an accent or marcato on the accented attack by CC11 at real players' +5.0 dB over the spiccato attack (rendermidi.h PLAIN_ACCENT_DB), so CC11 changes by 5.0 - db. Measured 2026-10-21 on the Windows test VM: kthost offline, Kontakt 8 + SSO, each patch from MuseScore's resaved setup (library defaults), CC1 64, CC11 as listed (Whence bar 8's staccato value; the Basses 64), each note after 1.5 s of silence, every semitone of the section's range, lengths 100 150 211 300 450 ms (from 450 ms on the window sees no note-off: 450 = 700 = 1000 ms within 0.2 dB on 15 keys), 2 rounds (64 122, 122 64; within 0.4 dB but at one key). db: the rounds' mean of 122 - 64, the perceived peak (tools/playbackverify/loudness.py perceived_envelope, loudness-level units, about dB) in the 0.4 s after the note-on, the measure of the real players' value; measured at the real players' level: each section's render scaled by gain (dB) so that its 64's median at 211 ms is 59.3 units, the median of the unaccented neighbours at f in the Spheres K. 550 study (the envelope is level-dependent: at kthost's unity level, 15-35 units, the differences came out 0.2-2 dB larger, up to 4.7 at single keys). level64: the 64's peak at that gain. The difference falls with length (the 64 swells while held) and changes from key to key (sample zones, mostly in pairs of semitones). Branch accent-level; gen_spitfire_sso.py writes accentedLevel= from it
